title: Kinh tế tài nguyên khoáng sản

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the economic aspects of mineral resources, including extraction, processing, and market dynamics.
Develop strategies for efficient management and utilization of mineral resources.
Evaluate and propose policies for sustainable resource management.
Apply economic principles to assess the costs and benefits of resource extraction.
Work effectively in teams to solve complex resource management problems.
Effectively communicate findings and solutions through presentations.
Analyze and solve economic and environmental issues related to mineral resources.
Identify and address practical issues in resource extraction and processing.
Evaluate the environmental impacts of mineral resource extraction and processing.
Understand market dynamics and government roles in mineral resource sectors.
